{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"call_199ee6561ab143aaa8feca6e","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t# Decisions & rationale\n2\t\n3\t## Naming\n4\t\n5\t**Trail Boss** — on a cattle drive, the trail boss is in overall command: sets the direction,\n6\tmakes the calls, and rides in when a steer bogs down or strays. The product runs a *herd* of\n7\tagent sessions; when one gets stuck it reports in, and you — the trail boss — ride over and set\n8\tit right. The metaphor maps cleanly onto the mechanism:\n9\t\n10\t- **the herd grazing the range** → sessions working autonomously\n11\t- **a steer bogs down or strays** → a `Stop` / `PermissionRequest` hook fires; the collector\n12\t  flags the session stuck\n13\t- **the trail boss rides over and sets it right** → you read the context and give the order\n14\t  (reply) or wave it on (skip); the queue surfaces stuck sessions oldest-first (flat FIFO, no\n15\t  priority ranking)\n16\t\n17\t### Names considered and rejected\n18\t\n19\t- **`agent-inbox`** — clearest literal description, but collides head-on with\n20\t  [`langchain-ai/agent-inbox`](https://github.com/langchain-ai/agent-inbox), an existing\n21\t  human-in-the-loop inbox for LangGraph agents. Would read as derivative and lose every search.\n22\t- **`agent-attention`** — names the value prop (your attention is the scarce resource being\n23\t  routed), but risks reading as the ML \"attention\" mechanism.\n24\t- **`agent-central`** — self-explanatory but generic, and \"central\" reads like a passive\n25\t  dashboard/hub rather than an act-on-the-stuck-one tool.\n26\t\n27\tTrail Boss keeps a memorable, distinctive identity; the tagline carries the legibility for\n28\tnewcomers.\n29\t\n30\t## Design decisions\n31\t\n32\t### Hooks, not polling\n33\t\n34\tDetection is event-driven via Claude Code hooks. A session emits a signal the moment control\n35\treturns to a human: while actively working it emits `PreToolUse`/`PostToolUse`, never `Stop`.\n36\tA session counts as waiting only once `Stop` or `PermissionRequest` has fired and no\n37\t`UserPromptSubmit` has come since. **Confirmed by probe (2026-05-25):** both `SessionStart` and\n38\t`Stop` fire in interactive and `-p` modes, the `Stop` payload carries `last_assistant_message`\n39\t(queue context for free), and hook commands inherit the ambient environment.\n40\t\n41\t### Stuck = needs attention, and stuck is stuck\n42\t\n43\tA session that has stopped or is waiting at a permission prompt cannot progress until the human\n44\tresponds — so it needs intervention by definition. Two collapses follow: there is no\n45\t\"finished but fine\" state (every stop is a queue item), and there is no permission-vs-stopped\n46\tpriority (it doesn't matter *why* it's stuck). `Stop` and `PermissionRequest` are both required\n47\tdetection triggers — a permission-blocked session is mid-turn and emits no `Stop` — but they're\n48\ttreated identically; `reason` is display-only and the queue is a flat FIFO dead-letter queue.\n49\t`Notification` is dropped (it adds nothing those two miss). The operator simply depletes the\n50\tqueue, and the next stuck session auto-loads.\n51\t\n52\t### Navigator, not relay (the delivery model)\n53\t\n54\tTrail Boss routes *attention*, it does not inject *input*. Sessions stay as long-running live\n55\tCLIs in tmux panes (Model A), and delivery happens by navigating the operator to the live pane\n56\t(`switch-client`/`select-window`/`select-pane`, optionally `link-window` to co-display) where\n57\tthey interact with the real prompt directly. This dissolves the send-keys fidelity problem,\n58\tmakes \"edit before allow\" native (you just type), and means no synthesized input ever reaches a\n59\tsession.\n60\t\n61\tRejected delivery alternatives:\n62\t\n63\t- **Resume-to-deliver** (`claude --resume <id>` in a second process): a live interactive CLI\n64\t  holds in-memory state and does not re-read its transcript, so a resumed process's reply never\n65\t  reaches the original pane; concurrent attach risks transcript divergence. `--fork-session`\n66\t  confirms plain `--resume` reuses the session. The product runs a *herd* of\nagent sessions; when one gets stuck it reports in, and you — the trail boss — ride over and set\nit right. The metaphor maps cleanly onto the mechanism:\n\n- **the herd grazing the range** → sessions working autonomously\n- **a steer bogs down or strays** → a `Stop` / `PermissionRequest` hook fires; the collector\n  flags the session stuck\n- **the trail boss rides over and sets it right** → you read the context and give the order\n  (reply) or wave it on (skip); the queue surfaces stuck sessions oldest-first (flat FIFO, no\n  priority ranking)\n\n### Names considered and rejected\n\n- **`agent-inbox`** — clearest literal description, but collides head-on with\n  [`langchain-ai/agent-inbox`](https://github.com/langchain-ai/agent-inbox), an existing\n  human-in-the-loop inbox for LangGraph agents. Would read as derivative and lose every search.\n- **`agent-attention`** — names the value prop (your attention is the scarce resource being\n  routed), but risks reading as the ML \"attention\" mechanism.\n- **`agent-central`** — self-explanatory but generic, and \"central\" reads like a passive\n  dashboard/hub rather than an act-on-the-stuck-one tool.\n\nTrail Boss keeps a memorable, distinctive identity; the tagline carries the legibility for\nnewcomers.\n\n## Design decisions\n\n### Hooks, not polling\n\nDetection is event-driven via Claude Code hooks. A session emits a signal the moment control\nreturns to a human: while actively working it emits `PreToolUse`/`PostToolUse`, never `Stop`.\nA session counts as waiting only once `Stop` or `PermissionRequest` has fired and no\n`UserPromptSubmit` has come since. **Confirmed by probe (2026-05-25):** both `SessionStart` and\n`Stop` fire in interactive and `-p` modes, the `Stop` payload carries `last_assistant_message`\n(queue context for free), and hook commands inherit the ambient environment.\n\n### Stuck = needs attention, and stuck is stuck\n\nA session that has stopped or is waiting at a permission prompt cannot progress until the human\nresponds — so it needs intervention by definition. Two collapses follow: there is no\n\"finished but fine\" state (every stop is a queue item), and there is no permission-vs-stopped\npriority (it doesn't matter *why* it's stuck). `Stop` and `PermissionRequest` are both required\ndetection triggers — a permission-blocked session is mid-turn and emits no `Stop` — but they're\ntreated identically; `reason` is display-only and the queue is a flat FIFO dead-letter queue.\n`Notification` is dropped (it adds nothing those two miss). The operator simply depletes the\nqueue, and the next stuck session auto-loads.\n\n### Navigator, not relay (the delivery model)\n\nTrail Boss routes *attention*, it does not inject *input*. Sessions stay as long-running live\nCLIs in tmux panes (Model A), and delivery happens by navigating the operator to the live pane\n(`switch-client`/`select-window`/`select-pane`, optionally `link-window` to co-display) where\nthey interact with the real prompt directly. This dissolves the send-keys fidelity problem,\nmakes \"edit before allow\" native (you just type), and means no synthesized input ever reaches a\nsession.\n\nRejected delivery alternatives:\n\n- **Resume-to-deliver** (`claude --resume <id>` in a second process): a live interactive CLI\n  holds in-memory state and does not re-read its transcript, so a resumed process's reply never\n  reaches the original pane; concurrent attach risks transcript divergence. `--fork-session`\n  confirms plain `--resume` reuses the session. Only viable in a no-resident-process model\n  (Model B), which we rejected for v1.\n- **`send-keys` relay as the primary path:** retained only as a secondary plain-text option\n  (basic submission confirmed working); native interaction is preferred.\n- **`claude --remote-control`:** routes to the claude.ai / desktop / mobile surface, not a local\n  channel — useless for a same-host tool.\n- **Agent SDK `canUseTool` (Model B):** programmatic permission gating with `updatedInput` is\n  attractive, but requires running sessions under the SDK instead of the terminal — deferred;\n  the tmux-navigator model fits the existing workflow and the durability requirement.\n\n### Same-host daemon, durable via tmux\n\nTrail Boss does not need to live *inside* tmux to drive it — tmux is client/server, so any\nsame-user process issues `tmux` commands to the server (pane ids are server-global). The\ncontrol plane is an always-on daemon; presentation is transient (`display-popup` + keybinding).\nBut for durability across SSH disconnect the daemon must survive SIGHUP, so it runs **in its own\ntmux window** (simplest) or under **`systemd --user`** (also survives reboot; tmux does not).\nAgents already persist because the tmux server is host-side. While disconnected, the daemon and\nhooks keep running, so the queue accumulates the backlog and disconnecting becomes a non-event.\n\n### The transcript is ground truth\n\nHooks are a low-latency notification; the transcript JSONL is authoritative. A reconcile loop\ncorrects dropped hook POSTs, daemon restarts, and \"answered directly in the pane\" by checking\nwhether a session's transcript has advanced past its last `Stop`.\n\n## Tmux Detector Viability (2026-07-02)\n\n### Question\nCan we build a purely tmux-level detector (no hooks) as a universal fallback for harnesses without hooks?\n\n### Verdict\n**VIABLE — Works as designed**\n\nThe tmux detector (`daemon/tmux-detector.ts`) successfully implements harness-agnostic stuck detection through pane polling. Install daemon dependencies\n\n```bash\ncd /path/to/trail-boss\nbun install\n```\n\n### 2. Build the TUI\n\n```bash\ncd /path/to/trail-boss/tui\ngo build -o ../bin/trailboss-tui .\n```\n\nThe `bin/trailboss-start` script will automatically build the TUI if the binary is missing.\n\n### 3. Wire Claude Code hooks\n\nAdd to your project's `.claude/settings.json`:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"hooks\": {\n    \"Stop\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"PermissionRequest\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"UserPromptSubmit\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"SessionStart\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"SessionEnd\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 3. Start Trail Boss\n\n```bash\nbin/trailboss-start\n```\n\nThis creates (or reuses) a `trail-boss` tmux session with two windows: `daemon` and\n`dashboard`. The dashboard shows the TUI on top (60%) and a live pane preview below (40%).\n\n### 4. Navigate\n\nFrom inside any tmux session:\n\n| Keybinding | Action |\n|------------|--------|\n| `prefix+Tab` | Jump to next stuck session |\n| `prefix+S` | Skip current head, jump to next |\n| `prefix+g` | Open queue picker popup |\n| `prefix+B` | Return to Trail Boss dashboard |\n\nOr source the provided `tmux.conf` to get these bindings:\n\n```bash\ntmux source-file /path/to/trail-boss/tmux.conf\n```\n\n### 5. Add to tmux status bar (optional)\n\n```conf\nset -g status-right \"#(bin/trailboss-status) | %H:%M\"\n```\n\nThe segment shows `⚠ N` when N sessions are stuck, blank otherwise.\n\n---\n\n## TUI keys\n\n| Key | Action |\n|-----|--------|\n| `j` / `k` | Move cursor down / up |\n| `gg` / `G` | Jump to top / bottom |\n| `Ctrl+d` / `Ctrl+u` | Half-page down / up |\n| `Enter` | Jump to selected pane |\n| `s` | Skip selected session (30 s cooldown) |\n| `l` / `Tab` | Focus detail pane |\n| `J` / `K` | Scroll detail pane |\n| `1`–`9` | Jump directly to queue position N |\n| `r` | Force refresh |\n| `?` | Toggle help overlay |\n| `q` | Quit |\n\n---\n\n## Repository layout\n\n```\ntrail-boss/\n├── daemon/\n│   ├── index.ts          # HTTP server + event ingest endpoint\n│   ├── claude-adapter.ts # Hook event normalization\n│   ├── db.ts             # SQLite state layer\n│   ├── reconcile.ts      # Transcript-advance reconcile loop\n│   ├── schema.sql        # Database schema\n│   └── types.ts          # Shared types\n├── tui/\n│   ├── main.go           # Entry point (AltScreen + mouse)\n│   ├── model.go          # Bubble Tea model + split layout\n│   ├── client.go         # Daemon HTTP client + tmux navigation\n│   └── theme.go          # Dracula palette + dumb-terminal fallback\n├── bin/\n│   ├── trailboss         # CLI: jump-next, skip, popup, return\n│   ├── trailboss-tui     # TUI binary (build from tui/ with Go)\n│   ├── trailboss-start   # Session launcher\n│   ├── trailboss-bootstrap # Initial setup script\n│   ├── trailboss-popup   # Queue picker popup (box-drawing UI)\n│   ├── trailboss-preview # Live pane capture loop\n│   ├── trailboss-status  # tmux status segment\n│   └── trailboss-watch   # (deprecated, superseded by TUI)\n├── docs/\n│   └── plan/plan.md      # Complete design spec\n├── .claude/\n│   └── trailboss-emit.sh # Hook emitter\n└── tmux.conf             # Keybinding configuration\n```\n\n---\n\n## Status\n\nPhases 1–9 complete. All 7 acceptance scenarios pass end-to-end.\n\n**What works:**\n- Hook detection: `Stop` and `PermissionRequest` enqueue; `UserPromptSubmit` dequeues\n- FIFO ordering with skip cooldown (30 s before a skipped session re-surfaces)\n- Reconcile loop: sessions dequeue automatically when transcripts advance (even if\n  `UserPromptSubmit` was missed because the daemon was temporarily down)\n- Self-healing registry: a session reappearing in a different pane re-registers\n- No forced focus-steal: resolving a session does not auto-switch you to another\n- TUI resolves pane IDs to human-readable tmux session names (alpha, bravo, etc.)\n\n**Upcoming:** refinements from daily use.\n\n---\n\n## Design principles\n\n**Stuck is stuck.** Whether a session hit a permission gate or just finished its turn —\nboth mean \"blocked until you act.\" The queue treats them identically; `reason` is\ndisplay-only metadata, never a routing input.\n\n**Navigator, not relay.** Trail Boss routes your attention to the live session. You interact\nwith the real CLI directly. It never injects replies or relays input.\n\n**Not a fleet spawner.** Trail Boss does not launch, kill, or cost-optimize agents. It assumes\nsessions already exist and surfaces the stuck ones.\n\n---\n\n## License\n\nMIT\n","numLines":271,"startLine":1,"totalLines":271}}}

Each stalled session — hitting a permission gate, asking a question, or finishing its\nturn — sits blocked until you notice it. With five or ten parallel sessions, most of your\nattention goes to *finding* the stuck one, not *answering* it.\n\nTrail Boss eliminates the cycling. Every session that stalls raises its hand automatically.\nYou see one prioritized queue, respond in the live pane, and move on.\n\n**Human on the loop, not in it.** The happy path never touches you. Only stalled work routes\nto you; you process the exception and it goes back on the wire.\n\n---\n\n## How it works\n\nTrail Boss integrates with Claude Code via hooks and tmux pane tracking:\n\n1. **Hook emitter** — Claude Code fires `Stop` and `PermissionRequest` hooks whenever a session\n   blocks. The emitter script (`trailboss-emit.sh`) POSTs each event to the daemon with the\n   current `$TMUX_PANE` ID.\n\n2. **Daemon** (Bun + SQLite, `localhost:4000`) — Maintains a session registry and FIFO queue.\n   Sessions enter the queue on `Stop`/`PermissionRequest` and leave when `UserPromptSubmit`\n   fires (you typed something in the pane) or when the reconcile loop detects the transcript\n   advanced on its own.\n\n3. **TUI** (Go + Bubble Tea) — Split-panel view: queue list on the left, session detail on the\n   right. Auto-refreshes every 3 seconds. Press `Enter` to jump to the head pane, `s` to skip\n   it (30 s cooldown before it re-surfaces).\n\n4. **Live preview** — A `tmux capture-pane` preview of the selected session updates in a pane\n   below the TUI as you navigate the queue.\n\n```\n┌─ Trail Boss ─────────────────── 3 stuck ──┐ ┌─ Detail ───────────────────────────────┐\n│ ▶ alpha    permission   2m14s              │ │ Wants to run:                          │\n│   bravo    stopped      0m48s              │ │ terraform apply -target=module.lb      │\n│   delta    stopped      0m11s              │ │                                        │\n│                                            │ │ CWD: ~/infra/modules                   │\n│ [enter] jump  [s] skip  [r] refresh  [?]  │ │ stuck 2m14s ago                        │\n└────────────────────────────────────────────┘ └────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n---\n\n## Architecture\n\n```\nClaude Code session (tmux pane)\n    │  Stop / PermissionRequest hook\n    ▼\n.claude/trailboss-emit.sh  ─── POST /event ──►  daemon (Bun + SQLite, :4000)\n                                                    │  reconcile loop (5 s)\n                                                    │  GET /queue  /next  /skip\n                                                    ▼\n                                                TUI (Go + Bubble Tea)\n                                                bin/trailboss-tui\n                                                    │  tmux switch-client / select-pane\n                                                    ▼\n                                                Target pane (live Claude Code session)\n```\n\n---\n\n## Components\n\n| Component | Language | Purpose |\n|-----------|----------|---------|\n| `daemon/` | TypeScript (Bun) | HTTP event ingestion, SQLite state, queue API |\n| `tui/` | Go (Bubble Tea) | Split-panel TUI dashboard |\n| `bin/trailboss` | Shell | CLI: `jump-next`, `skip`, `popup`, `return` |\n| `bin/trailboss-tui` | Go binary | TUI binary (build from tui/ with Go) |\n| `bin/trailboss-start` | Shell | Launches daemon + TUI in a `trail-boss` tmux session |\n| `bin/trailboss-preview` | Shell | Live pane capture loop for the split-view preview |\n| `bin/trailboss-status` | Shell | tmux status-bar segment showing stuck count |\n| `.claude/trailboss-emit.sh` | Shell | Hook emitter wired into Claude Code settings |\n\n---\n\n## Requirements\n\n- [Bun](https://bun.sh) — daemon runtime\n- tmux\n- Claude Code with hooks enabled\n- Go 1.24+ — for building the TUI\n\n---\n\n## Setup\n\n### 1. Install daemon dependencies\n\n```bash\ncd /path/to/trail-boss\nbun install\n```\n\n### 2. Build the TUI\n\n```bash\ncd /path/to/trail-boss/tui\ngo build -o ../bin/trailboss-tui .\n```\n\nThe `bin/trailboss-start` script will automatically build the TUI if the binary is missing.\n\n### 3. Wire Claude Code hooks\n\nAdd to your project's `.claude/settings.json`:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"hooks\": {\n    \"Stop\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"PermissionRequest\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"UserPromptSubmit\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"SessionStart\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"SessionEnd\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 3. Start Trail Boss\n\n```bash\nbin/trailboss-start\n```\n\nThis creates (or reuses) a `trail-boss` tmux session with two windows: `daemon` and\n`dashboard`. The dashboard shows the TUI on top (60%) and a live pane preview below (40%).\n\n### 4. Navigate\n\nFrom inside any tmux session:\n\n| Keybinding | Action |\n|------------|--------|\n| `prefix+Tab` | Jump to next stuck session |\n| `prefix+S` | Skip current head, jump to next |\n| `prefix+g` | Open queue picker popup |\n| `prefix+B` | Return to Trail Boss dashboard |\n\nOr source the provided `tmux.conf` to get these bindings:\n\n```bash\ntmux source-file /path/to/trail-boss/tmux.conf\n```\n\n### 5. Add to tmux status bar (optional)\n\n```conf\nset -g status-right \"#(bin/trailboss-status) | %H:%M\"\n```\n\nThe segment shows `⚠ N` when N sessions are stuck, blank otherwise.\n\n---\n\n## TUI keys\n\n| Key | Action |\n|-----|--------|\n| `j` / `k` | Move cursor down / up |\n| `gg` / `G` | Jump to top / bottom |\n| `Ctrl+d` / `Ctrl+u` | Half-page down / up |\n| `Enter` | Jump to selected pane |\n| `s` | Skip selected session (30 s cooldown) |\n| `l` / `Tab` | Focus detail pane |\n| `J` / `K` | Scroll detail pane |\n| `1`–`9` | Jump directly to queue position N |\n| `r` | Force refresh |\n| `?` | Toggle help overlay |\n| `q` | Quit |\n\n---\n\n## Repository layout\n\n```\ntrail-boss/\n├── daemon/\n│   ├── index.ts          # HTTP server + event ingest endpoint\n│   ├── claude-adapter.ts # Hook event normalization\n│   ├── db.ts             # SQLite state layer\n│   ├── reconcile.ts      # Transcript-advance reconcile loop\n│   ├── schema.sql        # Database schema\n│   └── types.ts          # Shared types\n├── tui/\n│   ├── main.go           # Entry point (AltScreen + mouse)\n│   ├── model.go          # Bubble Tea model + split layout\n│   ├── client.go         # Daemon HTTP client + tmux navigation\n│   └── theme.go          # Dracula palette + dumb-terminal fallback\n├── bin/\n│   ├── trailboss         # CLI: jump-next, skip, popup, return\n│   ├── trailboss-tui     # TUI binary (build from tui/ with Go)\n│   ├── trailboss-start   # Session launcher\n│   ├── trailboss-bootstrap # Initial setup script\n│   ├── trailboss-popup   # Queue picker popup (box-drawing UI)\n│   ├── trailboss-preview # Live pane capture loop\n│   ├── trailboss-status  # tmux status segment\n│   └── trailboss-watch   # (deprecated, superseded by TUI)\n├── docs/\n│   └── plan/plan.md      # Complete design spec\n├── .claude/\n│   └── trailboss-emit.sh # Hook emitter\n└── tmux.conf             # Keybinding configuration\n```\n\n---\n\n## Status\n\nPhases 1–9 complete. All 7 acceptance scenarios pass end-to-end.\n\n**What works:**\n- Hook detection: `Stop` and `PermissionRequest` enqueue; `UserPromptSubmit` dequeues\n- FIFO ordering with skip cooldown (30 s before a skipped session re-surfaces)\n- Reconcile loop: sessions dequeue automatically when transcripts advance (even if\n  `UserPromptSubmit` was missed because the daemon was temporarily down)\n- Self-healing registry: a session reappearing in a different pane re-registers\n- No forced focus-steal: resolving a session does not auto-switch you to another\n- TUI resolves pane IDs to human-readable tmux session names (alpha, bravo, etc.)\n\n**Upcoming:** refinements from daily use.\n\n---\n\n## Design principles\n\n**Stuck is stuck.** Whether a session hit a permission gate or just finished its turn —\nboth mean \"blocked until you act.\" The queue treats them identically; `reason` is\ndisplay-only metadata, never a routing input.\n\n**Navigator, not relay.** Trail Boss routes your attention to the live session. You interact\nwith the real CLI directly. It never injects replies or relays input.\n\n**Not a fleet spawner.** Trail Boss does not launch, kill, or cost-optimize agents. It assumes\nsessions already exist and surfaces the stuck ones.\n\n---\n\n## License\n\nMIT\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":92,"oldLines":7,"newStart":92,"newLines":7,"lines":[" "," - [Bun](https://bun.sh) — daemon runtime"," - tmux","-- Claude Code with hooks enabled","+- Claude Code with hooks enabled (for primary detection)"," - Go 1.24+ — for building the TUI"," "," ---"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

Hook-based detection (primary)\n\nClaude Code fires `Stop` and `PermissionRequest` hooks whenever a session blocks. The emitter script (`trailboss-emit.sh`) POSTs each event to the daemon with the current `$TMUX_PANE` ID. Each stalled session — hitting a permission gate, asking a question, or finishing its\nturn — sits blocked until you notice it. With five or ten parallel sessions, most of your\nattention goes to *finding* the stuck one, not *answering* it.\n\nTrail Boss eliminates the cycling. Every session that stalls raises its hand automatically.\nYou see one prioritized queue, respond in the live pane, and move on.\n\n**Human on the loop, not in it.** The happy path never touches you. Only stalled work routes\nto you; you process the exception and it goes back on the wire.\n\n---\n\n## How it works\n\nTrail Boss integrates with Claude Code via hooks and tmux pane tracking:\n\n1. **Hook emitter** — Claude Code fires `Stop` and `PermissionRequest` hooks whenever a session\n   blocks. The emitter script (`trailboss-emit.sh`) POSTs each event to the daemon with the\n   current `$TMUX_PANE` ID.\n\n2. **Daemon** (Bun + SQLite, `localhost:4000`) — Maintains a session registry and FIFO queue.\n   Sessions enter the queue on `Stop`/`PermissionRequest` and leave when `UserPromptSubmit`\n   fires (you typed something in the pane) or when the reconcile loop detects the transcript\n   advanced on its own.\n\n3. **TUI** (Go + Bubble Tea) — Split-panel view: queue list on the left, session detail on the\n   right. Auto-refreshes every 3 seconds. Press `Enter` to jump to the head pane, `s` to skip\n   it (30 s cooldown before it re-surfaces).\n\n4. **Live preview** — A `tmux capture-pane` preview of the selected session updates in a pane\n   below the TUI as you navigate the queue.\n\n```\n┌─ Trail Boss ─────────────────── 3 stuck ──┐ ┌─ Detail ───────────────────────────────┐\n│ ▶ alpha    permission   2m14s              │ │ Wants to run:                          │\n│   bravo    stopped      0m48s              │ │ terraform apply -target=module.lb      │\n│   delta    stopped      0m11s              │ │                                        │\n│                                            │ │ CWD: ~/infra/modules                   │\n│ [enter] jump  [s] skip  [r] refresh  [?]  │ │ stuck 2m14s ago                        │\n└────────────────────────────────────────────┘ └────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n---\n\n## Architecture\n\n```\nClaude Code session (tmux pane)\n    │  Stop / PermissionRequest hook\n    ▼\n.claude/trailboss-emit.sh  ─── POST /event ──►  daemon (Bun + SQLite, :4000)\n                                                    │  reconcile loop (5 s)\n                                                    │  GET /queue  /next  /skip\n                                                    ▼\n                                                TUI (Go + Bubble Tea)\n                                                bin/trailboss-tui\n                                                    │  tmux switch-client / select-pane\n                                                    ▼\n                                                Target pane (live Claude Code session)\n```\n\n---\n\n## Components\n\n| Component | Language | Purpose |\n|-----------|----------|---------|\n| `daemon/` | TypeScript (Bun) | HTTP event ingestion, SQLite state, queue API |\n| `tui/` | Go (Bubble Tea) | Split-panel TUI dashboard |\n| `bin/trailboss` | Shell | CLI: `jump-next`, `skip`, `popup`, `return` |\n| `bin/trailboss-tui` | Go binary | TUI binary (build from tui/ with Go) |\n| `bin/trailboss-start` | Shell | Launches daemon + TUI in a `trail-boss` tmux session |\n| `bin/trailboss-preview` | Shell | Live pane capture loop for the split-view preview |\n| `bin/trailboss-status` | Shell | tmux status-bar segment showing stuck count |\n| `.claude/trailboss-emit.sh` | Shell | Hook emitter wired into Claude Code settings |\n\n---\n\n## Requirements\n\n- [Bun](https://bun.sh) — daemon runtime\n- tmux\n- Claude Code with hooks enabled (for primary detection)\n- Go 1.24+ — for building the TUI\n\n---\n\n## Setup\n\n### 1. Install daemon dependencies\n\n```bash\ncd /path/to/trail-boss\nbun install\n```\n\n### 2. Build the TUI\n\n```bash\ncd /path/to/trail-boss/tui\ngo build -o ../bin/trailboss-tui .\n```\n\nThe `bin/trailboss-start` script will automatically build the TUI if the binary is missing.\n\n### 3. Wire Claude Code hooks\n\nAdd to your project's `.claude/settings.json`:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"hooks\": {\n    \"Stop\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"PermissionRequest\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"UserPromptSubmit\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"SessionStart\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"SessionEnd\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 3. Start Trail Boss\n\n```bash\nbin/trailboss-start\n```\n\nThis creates (or reuses) a `trail-boss` tmux session with two windows: `daemon` and\n`dashboard`. The dashboard shows the TUI on top (60%) and a live pane preview below (40%).\n\n### 4. Navigate\n\nFrom inside any tmux session:\n\n| Keybinding | Action |\n|------------|--------|\n| `prefix+Tab` | Jump to next stuck session |\n| `prefix+S` | Skip current head, jump to next |\n| `prefix+g` | Open queue picker popup |\n| `prefix+B` | Return to Trail Boss dashboard |\n\nOr source the provided `tmux.conf` to get these bindings:\n\n```bash\ntmux source-file /path/to/trail-boss/tmux.conf\n```\n\n### 5. Add to tmux status bar (optional)\n\n```conf\nset -g status-right \"#(bin/trailboss-status) | %H:%M\"\n```\n\nThe segment shows `⚠ N` when N sessions are stuck, blank otherwise.\n\n---\n\n## TUI keys\n\n| Key | Action |\n|-----|--------|\n| `j` / `k` | Move cursor down / up |\n| `gg` / `G` | Jump to top / bottom |\n| `Ctrl+d` / `Ctrl+u` | Half-page down / up |\n| `Enter` | Jump to selected pane |\n| `s` | Skip selected session (30 s cooldown) |\n| `l` / `Tab` | Focus detail pane |\n| `J` / `K` | Scroll detail pane |\n| `1`–`9` | Jump directly to queue position N |\n| `r` | Force refresh |\n| `?` | Toggle help overlay |\n| `q` | Quit |\n\n---\n\n## Repository layout\n\n```\ntrail-boss/\n├── daemon/\n│   ├── index.ts          # HTTP server + event ingest endpoint\n│   ├── claude-adapter.ts # Hook event normalization\n│   ├── db.ts             # SQLite state layer\n│   ├── reconcile.ts      # Transcript-advance reconcile loop\n│   ├── schema.sql        # Database schema\n│   └── types.ts          # Shared types\n├── tui/\n│   ├── main.go           # Entry point (AltScreen + mouse)\n│   ├── model.go          # Bubble Tea model + split layout\n│   ├── client.go         # Daemon HTTP client + tmux navigation\n│   └── theme.go          # Dracula palette + dumb-terminal fallback\n├── bin/\n│   ├── trailboss         # CLI: jump-next, skip, popup, return\n│   ├── trailboss-tui     # TUI binary (build from tui/ with Go)\n│   ├── trailboss-start   # Session launcher\n│   ├── trailboss-bootstrap # Initial setup script\n│   ├── trailboss-popup   # Queue picker popup (box-drawing UI)\n│   ├── trailboss-preview # Live pane capture loop\n│   ├── trailboss-status  # tmux status segment\n│   └── trailboss-watch   # (deprecated, superseded by TUI)\n├── docs/\n│   └── plan/plan.md      # Complete design spec\n├── .claude/\n│   └── trailboss-emit.sh # Hook emitter\n└── tmux.conf             # Keybinding configuration\n```\n\n---\n\n## Status\n\nPhases 1–9 complete. All 7 acceptance scenarios pass end-to-end.\n\n**What works:**\n- Hook detection: `Stop` and `PermissionRequest` enqueue; `UserPromptSubmit` dequeues\n- FIFO ordering with skip cooldown (30 s before a skipped session re-surfaces)\n- Reconcile loop: sessions dequeue automatically when transcripts advance (even if\n  `UserPromptSubmit` was missed because the daemon was temporarily down)\n- Self-healing registry: a session reappearing in a different pane re-registers\n- No forced focus-steal: resolving a session does not auto-switch you to another\n- TUI resolves pane IDs to human-readable tmux session names (alpha, bravo, etc.)\n\n**Upcoming:** refinements from daily use.\n\n---\n\n## Design principles\n\n**Stuck is stuck.** Whether a session hit a permission gate or just finished its turn —\nboth mean \"blocked until you act.\" The queue treats them identically; `reason` is\ndisplay-only metadata, never a routing input.\n\n**Navigator, not relay.** Trail Boss routes your attention to the live session. You interact\nwith the real CLI directly. It never injects replies or relays input.\n\n**Not a fleet spawner.** Trail Boss does not launch, kill, or cost-optimize agents. It assumes\nsessions already exist and surfaces the stuck ones.\n\n---\n\n## License\n\nMIT\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":73,"oldLines":6,"newStart":73,"newLines":62,"lines":[" "," ---"," ","+## Detection methods","+","+Trail Boss supports two detection methods:","+","+### 1. |","originalFile":"# Trail Boss\n\n**Single-pane attention router for interactive AI coding agents.** When you run multiple\nClaude Code (or other AI coding CLI) sessions in parallel tmux panes, Trail Boss surfaces the\nones waiting on you — a FIFO queue of stuck sessions — and jumps you directly to them with a\nkeystroke.\n\n---\n\n## The problem\n\nRunning many agent sessions in tmux means manually cycling windows to find the one that needs\nyou. Each stalled session — hitting a permission gate, asking a question, or finishing its\nturn — sits blocked until you notice it. With five or ten parallel sessions, most of your\nattention goes to *finding* the stuck one, not *answering* it.\n\nTrail Boss eliminates the cycling. Every session that stalls raises its hand automatically.\nYou see one prioritized queue, respond in the live pane, and move on.\n\n**Human on the loop, not in it.** The happy path never touches you. Only stalled work routes\nto you; you process the exception and it goes back on the wire.\n\n---\n\n## How it works\n\nTrail Boss integrates with Claude Code via hooks and tmux pane tracking:\n\n1. **Hook emitter** — Claude Code fires `Stop` and `PermissionRequest` hooks whenever a session\n   blocks. The emitter script (`trailboss-emit.sh`) POSTs each event to the daemon with the\n   current `$TMUX_PANE` ID.\n\n2. **Daemon** (Bun + SQLite, `localhost:4000`) — Maintains a session registry and FIFO queue.\n   Sessions enter the queue on `Stop`/`PermissionRequest` and leave when `UserPromptSubmit`\n   fires (you typed something in the pane) or when the reconcile loop detects the transcript\n   advanced on its own.\n\n3. **TUI** (Go + Bubble Tea) — Split-panel view: queue list on the left, session detail on the\n   right. Auto-refreshes every 3 seconds. Press `Enter` to jump to the head pane, `s` to skip\n   it (30 s cooldown before it re-surfaces).\n\n4. **Live preview** — A `tmux capture-pane` preview of the selected session updates in a pane\n   below the TUI as you navigate the queue.\n\n```\n┌─ Trail Boss ─────────────────── 3 stuck ──┐ ┌─ Detail ───────────────────────────────┐\n│ ▶ alpha    permission   2m14s              │ │ Wants to run:                          │\n│   bravo    stopped      0m48s              │ │ terraform apply -target=module.lb      │\n│   delta    stopped      0m11s              │ │                                        │\n│                                            │ │ CWD: ~/infra/modules                   │\n│ [enter] jump  [s] skip  [r] refresh  [?]  │ │ stuck 2m14s ago                        │\n└────────────────────────────────────────────┘ └────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n---\n\n## Architecture\n\n```\nClaude Code session (tmux pane)\n    │  Stop / PermissionRequest hook\n    ▼\n.claude/trailboss-emit.sh  ─── POST /event ──►  daemon (Bun + SQLite, :4000)\n                                                    │  reconcile loop (5 s)\n                                                    │  GET /queue  /next  /skip\n                                                    ▼\n                                                TUI (Go + Bubble Tea)\n                                                bin/trailboss-tui\n                                                    │  tmux switch-client / select-pane\n                                                    ▼\n                                                Target pane (live Claude Code session)\n```\n\n---\n\n## Detection methods\n\nTrail Boss supports two detection methods:\n\n### 1. Hook-based detection (primary)\n\nClaude Code fires `Stop` and `PermissionRequest` hooks whenever a session blocks. The emitter script (`trailboss-emit.sh`) POSTs each event to the daemon with the current `$TMUX_PANE` ID. This provides:\n\n- **Immediate detection**: Event-driven, no polling delay\n- **Full fidelity**: Includes session_id, transcript path, cwd, reason (permission vs stopped)\n- **Zero configuration**: Automatic for all Claude Code sessions with hooks enabled\n\n### 2. Tmux detector (fallback)\n\nFor coding harnesses without hook support, Trail Boss includes a **tmux-level detector** (`daemon/tmux-detector.ts`) that polls opted-in panes for stuck state. This provides:\n\n- **Harness-agnostic**: Works with any coding tool that runs in a tmux pane\n- **Low false positives**: 30-second quiet threshold + prompt pattern matching\n- **Opt-in required**: Panes must include `@tb-` prefix in their title\n\n**Enabling the tmux detector:**\n\n```bash\n# Method 1: Manual opt-in per pane\ntmux rename-window '@tb-my-work'\ntmux select-pane -T '@tb-task-name'\n\n# Method 2: Run detector standalone\ncd /home/coding/trail-boss\nbun run daemon/tmux-detector.ts\n\n# Method 3: Integrate with trailboss-start (automatic startup)\n# Edit bin/trailboss-start to add detector startup after daemon\n```\n\n**Configuration:**\n\n| Parameter | Environment Variable | Default |\n|-----------|---------------------|---------|\n| Poll interval | `TRAILBOSS_POLL_INTERVAL_MS` | 2000ms (2s) |\n| Quiet threshold | `TRAILBOSS_QUIET_THRESHOLD_MS` | 30000ms (30s) |\n| Opt-in prefix | `TRAILBOSS_OPT_IN_PREFIX` | `@tb-` |\n| Daemon URL | `TRAILBOSS_DAEMON_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:4000/event/normalized` |\n| Tmux socket | `TMUX` | `tmux` |\n\n**Operational considerations:**\n\n- **No transcript path**: Synthetic sessions (`tmux-%446-timestamp`) have no `transcript.jsonl` for reconcile\n- **No permission vs stopped distinction**: Always emits `reason: \"stopped\"`\n- **Opt-in compliance**: Users must remember the `@tb-` prefix\n- **Detection latency**: ~30s quiet threshold vs immediate hook-based detection\n\nFor Claude Code sessions, hook-based detection is primary (full fidelity, zero latency). The tmux detector enables Trail Boss to work with any future coding harness that lacks hooks. See `docs/notes/decisions.md` for full viability analysis and test results.\n\n---\n\n## Components\n\n| Component | Language | Purpose |\n|-----------|----------|---------|\n| `daemon/` | TypeScript (Bun) | HTTP event ingestion, SQLite state, queue API |\n| `tui/` | Go (Bubble Tea) | Split-panel TUI dashboard |\n| `bin/trailboss` | Shell | CLI: `jump-next`, `skip`, `popup`, `return` |\n| `bin/trailboss-tui` | Go binary | TUI binary (build from tui/ with Go) |\n| `bin/trailboss-start` | Shell | Launches daemon + TUI in a `trail-boss` tmux session |\n| `bin/trailboss-preview` | Shell | Live pane capture loop for the split-view preview |\n| `bin/trailboss-status` | Shell | tmux status-bar segment showing stuck count |\n| `.claude/trailboss-emit.sh` | Shell | Hook emitter wired into Claude Code settings |\n\n---\n\n## Requirements\n\n- [Bun](https://bun.sh) — daemon runtime\n- tmux\n- Claude Code with hooks enabled (for primary detection)\n- Go 1.24+ — for building the TUI\n\n---\n\n## Setup\n\n### 1. Install daemon dependencies\n\n```bash\ncd /path/to/trail-boss\nbun install\n```\n\n### 2. Build the TUI\n\n```bash\ncd /path/to/trail-boss/tui\ngo build -o ../bin/trailboss-tui .\n```\n\nThe `bin/trailboss-start` script will automatically build the TUI if the binary is missing.\n\n### 3. Wire Claude Code hooks\n\nAdd to your project's `.claude/settings.json`:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"hooks\": {\n    \"Stop\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"PermissionRequest\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"UserPromptSubmit\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"SessionStart\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"SessionEnd\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 3. Start Trail Boss\n\n```bash\nbin/trailboss-start\n```\n\nThis creates (or reuses) a `trail-boss` tmux session with two windows: `daemon` and\n`dashboard`. The dashboard shows the TUI on top (60%) and a live pane preview below (40%).\n\n### 4. Navigate\n\nFrom inside any tmux session:\n\n| Keybinding | Action |\n|------------|--------|\n| `prefix+Tab` | Jump to next stuck session |\n| `prefix+S` | Skip current head, jump to next |\n| `prefix+g` | Open queue picker popup |\n| `prefix+B` | Return to Trail Boss dashboard |\n\nOr source the provided `tmux.conf` to get these bindings:\n\n```bash\ntmux source-file /path/to/trail-boss/tmux.conf\n```\n\n### 5. Add to tmux status bar (optional)\n\n```conf\nset -g status-right \"#(bin/trailboss-status) | %H:%M\"\n```\n\nThe segment shows `⚠ N` when N sessions are stuck, blank otherwise.\n\n---\n\n## TUI keys\n\n| Key | Action |\n|-----|--------|\n| `j` / `k` | Move cursor down / up |\n| `gg` / `G` | Jump to top / bottom |\n| `Ctrl+d` / `Ctrl+u` | Half-page down / up |\n| `Enter` | Jump to selected pane |\n| `s` | Skip selected session (30 s cooldown) |\n| `l` / `Tab` | Focus detail pane |\n| `J` / `K` | Scroll detail pane |\n| `1`–`9` | Jump directly to queue position N |\n| `r` | Force refresh |\n| `?` | Toggle help overlay |\n| `q` | Quit |\n\n---\n\n## Repository layout\n\n```\ntrail-boss/\n├── daemon/\n│   ├── index.ts          # HTTP server + event ingest endpoint\n│   ├── claude-adapter.ts # Hook event normalization\n│   ├── db.ts             # SQLite state layer\n│   ├── reconcile.ts      # Transcript-advance reconcile loop\n│   ├── schema.sql        # Database schema\n│   └── types.ts          # Shared types\n├── tui/\n│   ├── main.go           # Entry point (AltScreen + mouse)\n│   ├── model.go          # Bubble Tea model + split layout\n│   ├── client.go         # Daemon HTTP client + tmux navigation\n│   └── theme.go          # Dracula palette + dumb-terminal fallback\n├── bin/\n│   ├── trailboss         # CLI: jump-next, skip, popup, return\n│   ├── trailboss-tui     # TUI binary (build from tui/ with Go)\n│   ├── trailboss-start   # Session launcher\n│   ├── trailboss-bootstrap # Initial setup script\n│   ├── trailboss-popup   # Queue picker popup (box-drawing UI)\n│   ├── trailboss-preview # Live pane capture loop\n│   ├── trailboss-status  # tmux status segment\n│   └── trailboss-watch   # (deprecated, superseded by TUI)\n├── docs/\n│   └── plan/plan.md      # Complete design spec\n├── .claude/\n│   └── trailboss-emit.sh # Hook emitter\n└── tmux.conf             # Keybinding configuration\n```\n\n---\n\n## Status\n\nPhases 1–9 complete. All 7 acceptance scenarios pass end-to-end.\n\n**What works:**\n- Hook detection: `Stop` and `PermissionRequest` enqueue; `UserPromptSubmit` dequeues\n- FIFO ordering with skip cooldown (30 s before a skipped session re-surfaces)\n- Reconcile loop: sessions dequeue automatically when transcripts advance (even if\n  `UserPromptSubmit` was missed because the daemon was temporarily down)\n- Self-healing registry: a session reappearing in a different pane re-registers\n- No forced focus-steal: resolving a session does not auto-switch you to another\n- TUI resolves pane IDs to human-readable tmux session names (alpha, bravo, etc.)\n\n**Upcoming:** refinements from daily use.\n\n---\n\n## Design principles\n\n**Stuck is stuck.** Whether a session hit a permission gate or just finished its turn —\nboth mean \"blocked until you act.\" The queue treats them identically; `reason` is\ndisplay-only metadata, never a routing input.\n\n**Navigator, not relay.** Trail Boss routes your attention to the live session. You interact\nwith the real CLI directly. It never injects replies or relays input.\n\n**Not a fleet spawner.** Trail Boss does not launch, kill, or cost-optimize agents. It assumes\nsessions already exist and surfaces the stuck ones.\n\n---\n\n## License\n\nMIT\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":134,"oldLines":6,"newStart":134,"newLines":7,"lines":[" | Component | Language | Purpose |"," |-----------|----------|---------|"," | `daemon/` | TypeScript (Bun) | HTTP event ingestion, SQLite state, queue API |","+| `daemon/tmux-detector.ts` | TypeScript (Bun) | Harness-agnostic fallback detector via pane polling |"," | `tui/` | Go (Bubble Tea) | Split-panel TUI dashboard |"," | `bin/trailboss` | Shell | CLI: `jump-next`, `skip`, `popup`, `return` |"," | `bin/trailboss-tui` | Go binary | TUI binary (build from tui/ with Go) |"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

Hook emitter\n└── tmux.conf             # Keybinding configuration\n```","originalFile":"# Trail Boss\n\n**Single-pane attention router for interactive AI coding agents.** When you run multiple\nClaude Code (or other AI coding CLI) sessions in parallel tmux panes, Trail Boss surfaces the\nones waiting on you — a FIFO queue of stuck sessions — and jumps you directly to them with a\nkeystroke.\n\n---\n\n## The problem\n\nRunning many agent sessions in tmux means manually cycling windows to find the one that needs\nyou. Each stalled session — hitting a permission gate, asking a question, or finishing its\nturn — sits blocked until you notice it. With five or ten parallel sessions, most of your\nattention goes to *finding* the stuck one, not *answering* it.\n\nTrail Boss eliminates the cycling. Every session that stalls raises its hand automatically.\nYou see one prioritized queue, respond in the live pane, and move on.\n\n**Human on the loop, not in it.** The happy path never touches you. Only stalled work routes\nto you; you process the exception and it goes back on the wire.\n\n---\n\n## How it works\n\nTrail Boss integrates with Claude Code via hooks and tmux pane tracking:\n\n1. **Hook emitter** — Claude Code fires `Stop` and `PermissionRequest` hooks whenever a session\n   blocks. The emitter script (`trailboss-emit.sh`) POSTs each event to the daemon with the\n   current `$TMUX_PANE` ID.\n\n2. **Daemon** (Bun + SQLite, `localhost:4000`) — Maintains a session registry and FIFO queue.\n   Sessions enter the queue on `Stop`/`PermissionRequest` and leave when `UserPromptSubmit`\n   fires (you typed something in the pane) or when the reconcile loop detects the transcript\n   advanced on its own.\n\n3. **TUI** (Go + Bubble Tea) — Split-panel view: queue list on the left, session detail on the\n   right. Auto-refreshes every 3 seconds. Press `Enter` to jump to the head pane, `s` to skip\n   it (30 s cooldown before it re-surfaces).\n\n4. **Live preview** — A `tmux capture-pane` preview of the selected session updates in a pane\n   below the TUI as you navigate the queue.\n\n```\n┌─ Trail Boss ─────────────────── 3 stuck ──┐ ┌─ Detail ───────────────────────────────┐\n│ ▶ alpha    permission   2m14s              │ │ Wants to run:                          │\n│   bravo    stopped      0m48s              │ │ terraform apply -target=module.lb      │\n│   delta    stopped      0m11s              │ │                                        │\n│                                            │ │ CWD: ~/infra/modules                   │\n│ [enter] jump  [s] skip  [r] refresh  [?]  │ │ stuck 2m14s ago                        │\n└────────────────────────────────────────────┘ └────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n---\n\n## Architecture\n\n```\nClaude Code session (tmux pane)\n    │  Stop / PermissionRequest hook\n    ▼\n.claude/trailboss-emit.sh  ─── POST /event ──►  daemon (Bun + SQLite, :4000)\n                                                    │  reconcile loop (5 s)\n                                                    │  GET /queue  /next  /skip\n                                                    ▼\n                                                TUI (Go + Bubble Tea)\n                                                bin/trailboss-tui\n                                                    │  tmux switch-client / select-pane\n                                                    ▼\n                                                Target pane (live Claude Code session)\n```\n\n---\n\n## Detection methods\n\nTrail Boss supports two detection methods:\n\n### 1. Hook-based detection (primary)\n\nClaude Code fires `Stop` and `PermissionRequest` hooks whenever a session blocks. The emitter script (`trailboss-emit.sh`) POSTs each event to the daemon with the current `$TMUX_PANE` ID. This provides:\n\n- **Immediate detection**: Event-driven, no polling delay\n- **Full fidelity**: Includes session_id, transcript path, cwd, reason (permission vs stopped)\n- **Zero configuration**: Automatic for all Claude Code sessions with hooks enabled\n\n### 2. Tmux detector (fallback)\n\nFor coding harnesses without hook support, Trail Boss includes a **tmux-level detector** (`daemon/tmux-detector.ts`) that polls opted-in panes for stuck state. This provides:\n\n- **Harness-agnostic**: Works with any coding tool that runs in a tmux pane\n- **Low false positives**: 30-second quiet threshold + prompt pattern matching\n- **Opt-in required**: Panes must include `@tb-` prefix in their title\n\n**Enabling the tmux detector:**\n\n```bash\n# Method 1: Manual opt-in per pane\ntmux rename-window '@tb-my-work'\ntmux select-pane -T '@tb-task-name'\n\n# Method 2: Run detector standalone\ncd /home/coding/trail-boss\nbun run daemon/tmux-detector.ts\n\n# Method 3: Integrate with trailboss-start (automatic startup)\n# Edit bin/trailboss-start to add detector startup after daemon\n```\n\n**Configuration:**\n\n| Parameter | Environment Variable | Default |\n|-----------|---------------------|---------|\n| Poll interval | `TRAILBOSS_POLL_INTERVAL_MS` | 2000ms (2s) |\n| Quiet threshold | `TRAILBOSS_QUIET_THRESHOLD_MS` | 30000ms (30s) |\n| Opt-in prefix | `TRAILBOSS_OPT_IN_PREFIX` | `@tb-` |\n| Daemon URL | `TRAILBOSS_DAEMON_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:4000/event/normalized` |\n| Tmux socket | `TMUX` | `tmux` |\n\n**Operational considerations:**\n\n- **No transcript path**: Synthetic sessions (`tmux-%446-timestamp`) have no `transcript.jsonl` for reconcile\n- **No permission vs stopped distinction**: Always emits `reason: \"stopped\"`\n- **Opt-in compliance**: Users must remember the `@tb-` prefix\n- **Detection latency**: ~30s quiet threshold vs immediate hook-based detection\n\nFor Claude Code sessions, hook-based detection is primary (full fidelity, zero latency). The tmux detector enables Trail Boss to work with any future coding harness that lacks hooks. See `docs/notes/decisions.md` for full viability analysis and test results.\n\n---\n\n## Components\n\n| Component | Language | Purpose |\n|-----------|----------|---------|\n| `daemon/` | TypeScript (Bun) | HTTP event ingestion, SQLite state, queue API |\n| `daemon/tmux-detector.ts` | TypeScript (Bun) | Harness-agnostic fallback detector via pane polling |\n| `tui/` | Go (Bubble Tea) | Split-panel TUI dashboard |\n| `bin/trailboss` | Shell | CLI: `jump-next`, `skip`, `popup`, `return` |\n| `bin/trailboss-tui` | Go binary | TUI binary (build from tui/ with Go) |\n| `bin/trailboss-start` | Shell | Launches daemon + TUI in a `trail-boss` tmux session |\n| `bin/trailboss-preview` | Shell | Live pane capture loop for the split-view preview |\n| `bin/trailboss-status` | Shell | tmux status-bar segment showing stuck count |\n| `.claude/trailboss-emit.sh` | Shell | Hook emitter wired into Claude Code settings |\n\n---\n\n## Requirements\n\n- [Bun](https://bun.sh) — daemon runtime\n- tmux\n- Claude Code with hooks enabled (for primary detection)\n- Go 1.24+ — for building the TUI\n\n---\n\n## Setup\n\n### 1. Install daemon dependencies\n\n```bash\ncd /path/to/trail-boss\nbun install\n```\n\n### 2. Build the TUI\n\n```bash\ncd /path/to/trail-boss/tui\ngo build -o ../bin/trailboss-tui .\n```\n\nThe `bin/trailboss-start` script will automatically build the TUI if the binary is missing.\n\n### 3. Wire Claude Code hooks\n\nAdd to your project's `.claude/settings.json`:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"hooks\": {\n    \"Stop\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"PermissionRequest\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"UserPromptSubmit\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"SessionStart\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"SessionEnd\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 3. Start Trail Boss\n\n```bash\nbin/trailboss-start\n```\n\nThis creates (or reuses) a `trail-boss` tmux session with two windows: `daemon` and\n`dashboard`. The dashboard shows the TUI on top (60%) and a live pane preview below (40%).\n\n### 4. Navigate\n\nFrom inside any tmux session:\n\n| Keybinding | Action |\n|------------|--------|\n| `prefix+Tab` | Jump to next stuck session |\n| `prefix+S` | Skip current head, jump to next |\n| `prefix+g` | Open queue picker popup |\n| `prefix+B` | Return to Trail Boss dashboard |\n\nOr source the provided `tmux.conf` to get these bindings:\n\n```bash\ntmux source-file /path/to/trail-boss/tmux.conf\n```\n\n### 5. Add to tmux status bar (optional)\n\n```conf\nset -g status-right \"#(bin/trailboss-status) | %H:%M\"\n```\n\nThe segment shows `⚠ N` when N sessions are stuck, blank otherwise.\n\n---\n\n## TUI keys\n\n| Key | Action |\n|-----|--------|\n| `j` / `k` | Move cursor down / up |\n| `gg` / `G` | Jump to top / bottom |\n| `Ctrl+d` / `Ctrl+u` | Half-page down / up |\n| `Enter` | Jump to selected pane |\n| `s` | Skip selected session (30 s cooldown) |\n| `l` / `Tab` | Focus detail pane |\n| `J` / `K` | Scroll detail pane |\n| `1`–`9` | Jump directly to queue position N |\n| `r` | Force refresh |\n| `?` | Toggle help overlay |\n| `q` | Quit |\n\n---\n\n## Repository layout\n\n```\ntrail-boss/\n├── daemon/\n│   ├── index.ts          # HTTP server + event ingest endpoint\n│   ├── claude-adapter.ts # Hook event normalization\n│   ├── db.ts             # SQLite state layer\n│   ├── reconcile.ts      # Transcript-advance reconcile loop\n│   ├── schema.sql        # Database schema\n│   └── types.ts          # Shared types\n├── tui/\n│   ├── main.go           # Entry point (AltScreen + mouse)\n│   ├── model.go          # Bubble Tea model + split layout\n│   ├── client.go         # Daemon HTTP client + tmux navigation\n│   └── theme.go          # Dracula palette + dumb-terminal fallback\n├── bin/\n│   ├── trailboss         # CLI: jump-next, skip, popup, return\n│   ├── trailboss-tui     # TUI binary (build from tui/ with Go)\n│   ├── trailboss-start   # Session launcher\n│   ├── trailboss-bootstrap # Initial setup script\n│   ├── trailboss-popup   # Queue picker popup (box-drawing UI)\n│   ├── trailboss-preview # Live pane capture loop\n│   ├── trailboss-status  # tmux status segment\n│   └── trailboss-watch   # (deprecated, superseded by TUI)\n├── docs/\n│   └── plan/plan.md      # Complete design spec\n├── .claude/\n│   └── trailboss-emit.sh # Hook emitter\n└── tmux.conf             # Keybinding configuration\n```\n\n---\n\n## Status\n\nPhases 1–9 complete. All 7 acceptance scenarios pass end-to-end.\n\n**What works:**\n- Hook detection: `Stop` and `PermissionRequest` enqueue; `UserPromptSubmit` dequeues\n- FIFO ordering with skip cooldown (30 s before a skipped session re-surfaces)\n- Reconcile loop: sessions dequeue automatically when transcripts advance (even if\n  `UserPromptSubmit` was missed because the daemon was temporarily down)\n- Self-healing registry: a session reappearing in a different pane re-registers\n- No forced focus-steal: resolving a session does not auto-switch you to another\n- TUI resolves pane IDs to human-readable tmux session names (alpha, bravo, etc.)\n\n**Upcoming:** refinements from daily use.\n\n---\n\n## Design principles\n\n**Stuck is stuck.** Whether a session hit a permission gate or just finished its turn —\nboth mean \"blocked until you act.\" The queue treats them identically; `reason` is\ndisplay-only metadata, never a routing input.\n\n**Navigator, not relay.** Trail Boss routes your attention to the live session. You interact\nwith the real CLI directly. It never injects replies or relays input.\n\n**Not a fleet spawner.** Trail Boss does not launch, kill, or cost-optimize agents. It assumes\nsessions already exist and surfaces the stuck ones.\n\n---\n\n## License\n\nMIT\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":267,"oldLines":7,"newStart":267,"newLines":8,"lines":[" │   ├── db.ts             # SQLite state layer"," │   ├── reconcile.ts      # Transcript-advance reconcile loop"," │   ├── schema.sql        # Database schema","-│   └── types.ts          # Shared types","+│   ├── types.ts          # Shared types","+│   └── tmux-detector.ts  # Harness-agnostic fallback detector"," ├── tui/"," │   ├── main.go           # Entry point (AltScreen + mouse)"," │   ├── model.go          # Bubble Tea model + split layout"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

Each stalled session — hitting a permission gate, asking a question, or finishing its\nturn — sits blocked until you notice it. With five or ten parallel sessions, most of your\nattention goes to *finding* the stuck one, not *answering* it.\n\nTrail Boss eliminates the cycling. Every session that stalls raises its hand automatically.\nYou see one prioritized queue, respond in the live pane, and move on.\n\n**Human on the loop, not in it.** The happy path never touches you. Only stalled work routes\nto you; you process the exception and it goes back on the wire.\n\n---\n\n## How it works\n\nTrail Boss integrates with Claude Code via hooks and tmux pane tracking:\n\n1. **Hook emitter** — Claude Code fires `Stop` and `PermissionRequest` hooks whenever a session\n   blocks. The emitter script (`trailboss-emit.sh`) POSTs each event to the daemon with the\n   current `$TMUX_PANE` ID.\n\n2. **Daemon** (Bun + SQLite, `localhost:4000`) — Maintains a session registry and FIFO queue.\n   Sessions enter the queue on `Stop`/`PermissionRequest` and leave when `UserPromptSubmit`\n   fires (you typed something in the pane) or when the reconcile loop detects the transcript\n   advanced on its own.\n\n3. **TUI** (Go + Bubble Tea) — Split-panel view: queue list on the left, session detail on the\n   right. Auto-refreshes every 3 seconds. Press `Enter` to jump to the head pane, `s` to skip\n   it (30 s cooldown before it re-surfaces).\n\n4. **Live preview** — A `tmux capture-pane` preview of the selected session updates in a pane\n   below the TUI as you navigate the queue.\n\n```\n┌─ Trail Boss ─────────────────── 3 stuck ──┐ ┌─ Detail ───────────────────────────────┐\n│ ▶ alpha    permission   2m14s              │ │ Wants to run:                          │\n│   bravo    stopped      0m48s              │ │ terraform apply -target=module.lb      │\n│   delta    stopped      0m11s              │ │                                        │\n│                                            │ │ CWD: ~/infra/modules                   │\n│ [enter] jump  [s] skip  [r] refresh  [?]  │ │ stuck 2m14s ago                        │\n└────────────────────────────────────────────┘ └────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n---\n\n## Architecture\n\n```\nClaude Code session (tmux pane)\n    │  Stop / PermissionRequest hook\n    ▼\n.claude/trailboss-emit.sh  ─── POST /event ──►  daemon (Bun + SQLite, :4000)\n                                                    │  reconcile loop (5 s)\n                                                    │  GET /queue  /next  /skip\n                                                    ▼\n                                                TUI (Go + Bubble Tea)\n                                                bin/trailboss-tui\n                                                    │  tmux switch-client / select-pane\n                                                    ▼\n                                                Target pane (live Claude Code session)\n```\n\n---\n\n## Detection methods\n\nTrail Boss supports two detection methods:\n\n### 1. Hook-based detection (primary)\n\nClaude Code fires `Stop` and `PermissionRequest` hooks whenever a session blocks. The emitter script (`trailboss-emit.sh`) POSTs each event to the daemon with the current `$TMUX_PANE` ID. This provides:\n\n- **Immediate detection**: Event-driven, no polling delay\n- **Full fidelity**: Includes session_id, transcript path, cwd, reason (permission vs stopped)\n- **Zero configuration**: Automatic for all Claude Code sessions with hooks enabled\n\n### 2. Tmux detector (fallback)\n\nFor coding harnesses without hook support, Trail Boss includes a **tmux-level detector** (`daemon/tmux-detector.ts`) that polls opted-in panes for stuck state. This provides:\n\n- **Harness-agnostic**: Works with any coding tool that runs in a tmux pane\n- **Low false positives**: 30-second quiet threshold + prompt pattern matching\n- **Opt-in required**: Panes must include `@tb-` prefix in their title\n\n**Enabling the tmux detector:**\n\n```bash\n# Method 1: Manual opt-in per pane\ntmux rename-window '@tb-my-work'\ntmux select-pane -T '@tb-task-name'\n\n# Method 2: Run detector standalone\ncd /home/coding/trail-boss\nbun run daemon/tmux-detector.ts\n\n# Method 3: Integrate with trailboss-start (automatic startup)\n# Edit bin/trailboss-start to add detector startup after daemon\n```\n\n**Configuration:**\n\n| Parameter | Environment Variable | Default |\n|-----------|---------------------|---------|\n| Poll interval | `TRAILBOSS_POLL_INTERVAL_MS` | 2000ms (2s) |\n| Quiet threshold | `TRAILBOSS_QUIET_THRESHOLD_MS` | 30000ms (30s) |\n| Opt-in prefix | `TRAILBOSS_OPT_IN_PREFIX` | `@tb-` |\n| Daemon URL | `TRAILBOSS_DAEMON_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:4000/event/normalized` |\n| Tmux socket | `TMUX` | `tmux` |\n\n**Operational considerations:**\n\n- **No transcript path**: Synthetic sessions (`tmux-%446-timestamp`) have no `transcript.jsonl` for reconcile\n- **No permission vs stopped distinction**: Always emits `reason: \"stopped\"`\n- **Opt-in compliance**: Users must remember the `@tb-` prefix\n- **Detection latency**: ~30s quiet threshold vs immediate hook-based detection\n\nFor Claude Code sessions, hook-based detection is primary (full fidelity, zero latency). The tmux detector enables Trail Boss to work with any future coding harness that lacks hooks. See `docs/notes/decisions.md` for full viability analysis and test results.\n\n---\n\n## Components\n\n| Component | Language | Purpose |\n|-----------|----------|---------|\n| `daemon/` | TypeScript (Bun) | HTTP event ingestion, SQLite state, queue API |\n| `daemon/tmux-detector.ts` | TypeScript (Bun) | Harness-agnostic fallback detector via pane polling |\n| `tui/` | Go (Bubble Tea) | Split-panel TUI dashboard |\n| `bin/trailboss` | Shell | CLI: `jump-next`, `skip`, `popup`, `return` |\n| `bin/trailboss-tui` | Go binary | TUI binary (build from tui/ with Go) |\n| `bin/trailboss-start` | Shell | Launches daemon + TUI in a `trail-boss` tmux session |\n| `bin/trailboss-preview` | Shell | Live pane capture loop for the split-view preview |\n| `bin/trailboss-status` | Shell | tmux status-bar segment showing stuck count |\n| `.claude/trailboss-emit.sh` | Shell | Hook emitter wired into Claude Code settings |\n\n---\n\n## Requirements\n\n- [Bun](https://bun.sh) — daemon runtime\n- tmux\n- Claude Code with hooks enabled (for primary detection)\n- Go 1.24+ — for building the TUI\n\n---\n\n## Setup\n\n### 1. Install daemon dependencies\n\n```bash\ncd /path/to/trail-boss\nbun install\n```\n\n### 2. Build the TUI\n\n```bash\ncd /path/to/trail-boss/tui\ngo build -o ../bin/trailboss-tui .\n```\n\nThe `bin/trailboss-start` script will automatically build the TUI if the binary is missing.\n\n### 3. Wire Claude Code hooks\n\nAdd to your project's `.claude/settings.json`:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"hooks\": {\n    \"Stop\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"PermissionRequest\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"UserPromptSubmit\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"SessionStart\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }],\n    \"SessionEnd\": [{\n      \"type\": \"command\",\n      \"command\": \"/path/to/trail-boss/.claude/trailboss-emit.sh\"\n    }]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 3. Start Trail Boss\n\n```bash\nbin/trailboss-start\n```\n\nThis creates (or reuses) a `trail-boss` tmux session with two windows: `daemon` and\n`dashboard`. The dashboard shows the TUI on top (60%) and a live pane preview below (40%).\n\n### 4. Navigate\n\nFrom inside any tmux session:\n\n| Keybinding | Action |\n|------------|--------|\n| `prefix+Tab` | Jump to next stuck session |\n| `prefix+S` | Skip current head, jump to next |\n| `prefix+g` | Open queue picker popup |\n| `prefix+B` | Return to Trail Boss dashboard |\n\nOr source the provided `tmux.conf` to get these bindings:\n\n```bash\ntmux source-file /path/to/trail-boss/tmux.conf\n```\n\n### 5. Add to tmux status bar (optional)\n\n```conf\nset -g status-right \"#(bin/trailboss-status) | %H:%M\"\n```\n\nThe segment shows `⚠ N` when N sessions are stuck, blank otherwise.\n\n---\n\n## TUI keys\n\n| Key | Action |\n|-----|--------|\n| `j` / `k` | Move cursor down / up |\n| `gg` / `G` | Jump to top / bottom |\n| `Ctrl+d` / `Ctrl+u` | Half-page down / up |\n| `Enter` | Jump to selected pane |\n| `s` | Skip selected session (30 s cooldown) |\n| `l` / `Tab` | Focus detail pane |\n| `J` / `K` | Scroll detail pane |\n| `1`–`9` | Jump directly to queue position N |\n| `r` | Force refresh |\n| `?` | Toggle help overlay |\n| `q` | Quit |\n\n---\n\n## Repository layout\n\n```\ntrail-boss/\n├── daemon/\n│   ├── index.ts          # HTTP server + event ingest endpoint\n│   ├── claude-adapter.ts # Hook event normalization\n│   ├── db.ts             # SQLite state layer\n│   ├── reconcile.ts      # Transcript-advance reconcile loop\n│   ├── schema.sql        # Database schema\n│   ├── types.ts          # Shared types\n│   └── tmux-detector.ts  # Harness-agnostic fallback detector\n├── tui/\n│   ├── main.go           # Entry point (AltScreen + mouse)\n│   ├── model.go          # Bubble Tea model + split layout\n│   ├── client.go         # Daemon HTTP client + tmux navigation\n│   └── theme.go          # Dracula palette + dumb-terminal fallback\n├── bin/\n│   ├── trailboss         # CLI: jump-next, skip, popup, return\n│   ├── trailboss-tui     # TUI binary (build from tui/ with Go)\n│   ├── trailboss-start   # Session launcher\n│   ├── trailboss-bootstrap # Initial setup script\n│   ├── trailboss-popup   # Queue picker popup (box-drawing UI)\n│   ├── trailboss-preview # Live pane capture loop\n│   ├── trailboss-status  # tmux status segment\n│   └── trailboss-watch   # (deprecated, superseded by TUI)\n├── docs/\n│   └── plan/plan.md      # Complete design spec\n├── .claude/\n│   └── trailboss-emit.sh # Hook emitter\n└── tmux.conf             # Keybinding configuration\n```\n\n---\n\n## Status\n\nPhases 1–9 complete. All 7 acceptance scenarios pass end-to-end.\n\n**What works:**\n- Hook detection: `Stop` and `PermissionRequest` enqueue; `UserPromptSubmit` dequeues\n- FIFO ordering with skip cooldown (30 s before a skipped session re-surfaces)\n- Reconcile loop: sessions dequeue automatically when transcripts advance (even if\n  `UserPromptSubmit` was missed because the daemon was temporarily down)\n- Self-healing registry: a session reappearing in a different pane re-registers\n- No forced focus-steal: resolving a session does not auto-switch you to another\n- TUI resolves pane IDs to human-readable tmux session names (alpha, bravo, etc.)\n\n**Upcoming:** refinements from daily use.\n\n---\n\n## Design principles\n\n**Stuck is stuck.** Whether a session hit a permission gate or just finished its turn —\nboth mean \"blocked until you act.\" The queue treats them identically; `reason` is\ndisplay-only metadata, never a routing input.\n\n**Navigator, not relay.** Trail Boss routes your attention to the live session. You interact\nwith the real CLI directly. It never injects replies or relays input.\n\n**Not a fleet spawner.** Trail Boss does not launch, kill, or cost-optimize agents.
